prompt: Create a Python class for managing user sessions in Valkey. It should have methods to create_session(user_id, data), get_session(session_id), and delete_session(session_id). Use proper design patterns and avoid common anti-patterns.

assertions.name: Uses dependency injection
assertions.description: Should inject client as dependency, not create it in __init__

assertions.name: Avoids static-only class
assertions.description: Should use proper class with instance methods or module-level functions, not static-only class

assertions.name: Returns status not exceptions
assertions.description: Should return status dicts or values, not use exceptions for control flow

assertions.name: Uses Protocol for abstraction
assertions.description: Should use Protocol-based abstraction or proper interface, not tight coupling to GlideClient

assertions.name: Demonstrates proper client usage
assertions.description: Example usage should show async context manager for client lifecycle
